column2: [This.GetTitledFirstName] is tired of being counted among the merely competent. [This.GetSheHe] will train until [This.GetSheHe] stands among the true masters of the art.
[This.GetTitledFirstName] has reached the summit of ordinary mastery and found it wanting. [This.GetSheHe] means to push beyond it, into the realm reserved for legends.
The old masters whispered of techniques hidden from common benders, taught only to a trusted few. [This.GetTitledFirstName] intends to uncover one of them.
[This.GetTitledFirstName] seeks to still the noise of the world and reach true spiritual understanding, whatever it may cost.
The marriage bed has grown cold and the nights are long. [This.GetTitledFirstName] desires someone to warm them.
[This.GetTitledFirstName] means to earn the trust and affection of [This.GetHerHis] lord, and with it a measure of security.
[This.GetTitledFirstName] dreams of a crowded hall, of many children and many heirs to carry the family name.

[This.GetTitledFirstName] has decided that competent is not enough. [This.GetSheHe] will drill, spar and study until [This.GetSheHe] stands among the finest warriors of the age - and perhaps beyond them.
